description: Explain a plan, a shape, a shipped change, code, or the last message so it's impossible to misunderstand — an ASCII drawing of how it works, then plain words, facts kept verbatim. Like SQL's EXPLAIN for a query plan. Use when someone says "explain simply", "use ascii to explain", "explain the plan to me", "that didn't land", "too dense", "I don't get it", "walk me through what we shipped", or needs to understand and defend a system to their team.
